experiment: historical DYSANOS states; spot reset to one; model-fitted maximum-mean one-day portfolio; frozen execution on the next observed market

portfolio_problem.objective: maximize conditional sample mean net PnL
constraints: global L1 action norm is at most one
portfolio_problem.instruments: one spot coordinate and 7x20 DYSANOS-grid calls with fixed cash strikes

out_of_sample_rule: freeze each fitted action and mark its fixed contracts from the observed surface on date t to the observed surface at the next market record; the next record is treated as one trading day and is not used during optimization
